shortDescription: Allows administration of Keycloak client roles scope to restrict the usage of certain roles to a other specific client applications

options.name: auth_client_id
options.description: OpenID Connect C(client_id) to authenticate to the API with.

options.name: auth_client_secret
options.description: Client Secret to use in conjunction with O(auth_client_id) (if required).

options.name: auth_password
options.description: Password to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: auth_realm
options.description: Keycloak realm name to authenticate to for API access.

options.name: auth_username
options.description: Username to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: client_id
options.description: Roles provided in O(role_names) while be added to this client scope.

options.name: client_scope_id
options.description: If the O(role_names) are client role, the client ID under which it resides. If this parameter is absent, the roles are considered a realm role.

options.name: connection_timeout
options.description: Controls the HTTP connections timeout period (in seconds) to Keycloak API.

options.name: realm
options.description: The Keycloak realm under which clients resides.

options.name: refresh_token
options.description: Authentication refresh token for Keycloak API.

options.name: role_names
options.description: Names of roles to manipulate. If O(client_scope_id) is present, all roles must be under this client. If O(client_scope_id) is absent, all roles must be under the realm.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the role mapping. On V(present), all roles in O(role_names) are mapped if not exist yet. On V(absent), all roles mapping in O(role_names) are removed if it exists.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Verify TLS certificates (do not disable this in production).
